ἑβδομηκοντάκις, adv.,

seventy times: ἑ. ἑπτά, seventy times seven, Mat.18:22 (R, txt., ICC, in l.), or seventy-seven times (R, mg.; cf. M, Pr., 98; WM, 314; Meyer, in l.).†
